title: Design 1M TPS Real-Time Fraud & Activity Pipeline
subtitle: Transactional Outbox + Debezium CDC -> Kafka -> Flink Actors + Watermarks & Blackboard Rules
functionalReqs: Ingest `1,000,000` payment & auth events/sec across `100M` accounts, computing 5m/1h/24h velocity features within `40 ms`.
Project settled transactions atomically from core PostgreSQL ledgers to Activity Feeds & Search indexes with zero dual-write split brain.
Evaluate multi-stage velocity rules + ML fraud scores via decoupled Actor & Blackboard stages resilient to out-of-order mobile retries.

nonFunctionalReqs.rationale: Keyed across 256 Kafka partitions (~4k msg/sec per partition).
In-memory RocksDB keyed Flink actors maintain HyperLogLog distinct counters lock-free.

nonFunctionalReqs.target: Out-of-order mobile retries up to 120s handled cleanly
nonFunctionalReqs.rationale: Event-Time Watermarks + bounded allowedLateness prevent processing-time blind spots.

workedSummary.streamBandwidth: 1M/s × 600 B = 600 MB/s raw -> 1.8 GB/s RF=3 Kafka replication (~256 partitions)
workedSummary.flinkActorState: 20M active accounts × 256 B HyperLogLog sketch = ~5.1 GB local RocksDB state
workedSummary.dedupeCache: 1M/s × 15m TTL dedupe key = ~21 GB partitioned Redis / RocksDB idempotent sink index

explorerTopology.title: 1M TPS Outbox CDC -> Flink Actors -> CQRS Views
explorerTopology.subtitle: Breaking Temporal Coupling via Log Brokers, Watermarks & Blackboard Risk Signals
explorerTopology.overview: How principal streaming architectures replace fragile synchronous HTTP chains & SQL cron jobs with Debezium WAL CDC, Kafka, stateful Flink actors, and idempotent CQRS projections.
keyTakeaways: Transactional Outbox + Debezium WAL CDC guarantees DB commits and Kafka events never split-brain.
Event-Time Watermarks + Actor partitioning handle 1M TPS + late mobile arrivals without global locks.

nodes.label: Core Ledger + Outbox DB
nodes.summary: Commits domain row + `outbox_events` atomically in one transaction.
failureModes: Publishing to Kafka outside local ACID tx leaks phantom/dropped events

nodes.label: Debezium WAL CDC
nodes.summary: Streams committed WAL LSN changes to Kafka cleanly without polling production OLTP tables.
failureModes: Restart without LSN dedupe replays already-produced messages

nodes.label: Kafka 256 Partitions
nodes.summary: Retains ordered partitioned transaction streams across multiple independent consumer groups.
failureModes: Un-salted mega-merchant keys skew single partition consumer lag

nodes.label: Flink Keyed Actors
nodes.summary: Computes 5m/1h velocity & HyperLogLog distinct card sketches with bounded-lateness Watermarks.
failureModes: Naive processing-time windows miss delayed mobile bursts

nodes.label: Blackboard & Feed Sinks
nodes.summary: Posts risk flags on Fraud Blackboard & updates user Activity Feeds idempotently despite replays.
whenToUse: CQRS read projections & decoupled risk scoring (TPP Blackboard)
failureModes: Non-idempotent counters inflate totals on consumer restart

steps.info: Ledger commits payment + `outbox_events` atomically; Debezium streams WAL record in 5ms.
steps.payloadInspector:
BEGIN; INSERT ledger + INSERT outbox; COMMIT;
WAL LSN #884129
steps.inspectorNote: Zero dual-write gap and zero polling queries on OLTP tables.

steps.info: Writes cleanly to 256 partitions keyed by `account_id` (`acks=all`, `min.insync.replicas=2`).
steps.inspectorNote: Both Flink Fraud Engine and Feed Projectors consume independently without touching OLTP DB.

steps.info: Isolated per-account Actor updates 5m velocity & HyperLogLog distinct card count governed by `W(t) = maxEventTime - 120s`.
steps.payloadInspector:
Actor: acc_401 | 5m_tx_count: 14
Watermark: 1794979880000 (handles late mobile retries)
steps.inspectorNote: Actors prevent lock contention while Event-Time watermarks handle out-of-order mobile retries cleanly.

steps.info: Posts velocity anomaly on Fraud Blackboard & writes feed row via `ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING`.
steps.payloadInspector: Feed Dedupe Key: evt_771 (At-least-once + idempotent sink = effective once!)
steps.inspectorNote: Even if a worker crashes before committing offsets, replayed events never duplicate balances or feed alerts.

chaosScenarios.title: Flink Worker Eviction + 90s Late Mobile Event Flood
chaosScenarios.triggerSummary: Flink TaskManager crashes mid-checkpoint while subway mobile devices dump 90s-delayed transactions.
chaosScenarios.mitigationSummary: New TaskManager restores incremental S3 RocksDB checkpoint, replays from last Kafka offset cleanly, handles late arrivals via `allowedLateness`, and sink deduplicates by `event_id`.

steps.info: Recovers checkpoint from S3 in 3s; replays uncommitted offset slice cleanly and evaluates late 90s mobile batch.
steps.payloadInspector:
Recovered Checkpoint #4112
AllowedLateness 120s caught burst accurately!
steps.inspectorNote: Incremental checkpoints + idempotent sinks make 1M TPS crash recovery routine.

tradeoffs.option: Outbox CDC + Kafka + Keyed Flink Actors + Watermarks
pros: Handles 1M TPS & late arrivals with zero DB polling load
cons: Operational complexity of Kafka ISR, Flink S3 checkpoints & idempotent sinks
tradeoffs.bestFor: Real-time fraud velocity engines, telemetry, and high-scale feeds

deepDives.title: Mega-Merchant Partition Skew Salting in Kafka + Flink
deepDives.bottleneck: 1 large enterprise merchant (`account_id = big_retailer`) accounts for 12% of traffic, hot-spotting 1 of 256 Flink slots.
deepDives.solution: Detect top-K heavy hitters and salt only their partition keys (`big_retailer#0..15`), running a fast two-stage pre-aggregate -> global merge.
deepDives.tradeoff: Preserves exact single-key ordering for 99.99% of normal accounts while scaling hot accounts horizontally.

deepDives.title: Actor + Blackboard Orthogonal Evolution
deepDives.bottleneck: Hardcoding ML fraud checks, velocity counters, and notification emails inside one monolith creates fragile release bottlenecks.
deepDives.solution: Flink Actors compute window features asynchronously and post risk evidence onto a decoupled Blackboard rules coordinator.
deepDives.tradeoff: Teams deploy new fraud signals independently without touching core ledger or payment authorization code (TPP ETC).

criteria: Eliminates app-level dual writes & DB cron polling via Transactional Outbox + WAL Debezium CDC
Sizes 256 partitions at 1M TPS, explains ISR durability and idempotent sink deduplication
Distinguishes Event-Time vs Processing-Time windows and sets Bounded-Out-of-Orderness watermarks
Applies TPP Breaking Temporal Coupling, keyed Flink Actors, Blackboard signals, and CQRS views
